record_type_quote: In this preregistered study, we directly replicated Luke et al.'s (2012) Study 2 (N = 281).

targets.evidence_quote: In this preregistered study, we directly replicated Luke et al.'s (2012) Study 2 (N = 281).
targets.outcome_quote: We found similar results as the replicated study regarding increased security feelings and exploration motivations on the self-report measures after the priming. However, we did not find any support for the increased energy feelings after the attachment security priming. In addition, contrary to Luke et al.'s (2012) results, energy feelings did not mediate the relationship between security priming and exploration motivations.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Authors explicitly report agreement on security and exploration, but disagreement on energy and mediation.
